university.name: Lovely Professional University (LPU)
university.address: Jalandhar - Delhi, Grand Trunk Rd, Phagwara, Punjab 144411
university.act: Lovely Professional University Act, 2005 (Punjab Act No. 25 of 2005)

resolving_issues.general_queries: DSR (Division of Student Relation) Block no 30 room no 103
resolving_issues.hostel_issues: Warden office of your hostel on ground floor or via RMS
resolving_issues.mental_health_and_counselling: If feeling depressed or need counseling, contact the Department of Counselling and Happiness Block 11
resolving_issues.lost_and_found: If anything is lost, go to the Lost and Found department

rms_process.access: Log in to LPU UMS -> Dashboard -> RMS section
options: Log Request to raise a new query
Log Status to check existing ones

specific_paths.lor: UMS → RMS → Master Category → Records and Certificates → Sub Category → Letter of Recommendation

resolving_issues.backlog: Students can register for backlog courses via UMS and select class sections that fit their schedule.
resolving_issues.turnstile_and_id_issues: For turnstile access issues (face/fingerprint ID not working) or lost ID cards, please visit Room 103 in Block 31 (Admission Block).

pep_classes.regular: Professional Enhancement Program (PEP) classes are designed for students registered for placements. They offer training in specific skills like DSA, Web Development, and Data Science. Industry mentors often come to teach these classes to make students industry-ready.
pep_classes.cse_special_merit: A special merit-based PEP class is available exclusively for 2nd-year CSE students. It also features teaching by industry mentors and prepares students for placements early, allowing them to participate in campus placements starting in their 5th semester.

facilities: In-campus residential facilities (AC/Non-AC, 1 to multi-seater, Gym, Laundry, Swimming pool, Sports facilities)

major_schools: School of Computer Science and Engineering

fees_estimated.btech: Around ₹1.4L to ₹2L+ per semester (e.g. Some CSE specializations = ₹2,00,000/sem before scholarship)
fees_estimated.bca_bba: Usually lower than B.Tech, varies by specialization
fees_estimated.phd: Many PhD programs show ₹50,000 fee category

important_blocks.student_welfare_wing: Block 13 DSW Block (Known for clubs, cultural activities, and student welfare)

best_food_shops: Kitchen Ette in CC (Near Uni Hospital)
Lovely Bake Studio for Desserts and icecream (near apartment)
Lovely Sweets for Sweets, samosas and all

parcel_and_post.online_parcels: For parcels from Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, etc., go to UniMall's 4th floor where they have Delhivery and other courier services.
parcel_and_post.postal_services: IndianPost is located near the apartments where you can get or send post.

edu_revolution.description: A program that gives students flexibility and rewards based on skills and achievements.

benefits.RPL (Recognition of Prior Learning): Skip classes if you already know the subject.
benefits.Grade Upgradation: Improve grades using certifications, patents, or research papers.
benefits.Attendance Relaxation: Get attendance benefit for internships, certifications, or competitions.

attendance_and_leaves.duty_leave: Duty Leave (DL) is granted only for officially announced LPU sessions that explicitly provide it. Students can avail a maximum of 10% of their total semester classes as DL.
